events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as "The White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Drop
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic double LP, 'The White Album'. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us far too soon on this day in 1991. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, "Rubber Soul," on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Drop
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed a new direction for the Fab Four.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: John Lennon, an influential member of The Beatles, was tragically killed on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who we lost on this day in 1980. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the iconic musician and artist, would have celebrated his 80th birthday on January 8, 2027.

angles.name: Starman 80
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Celebrating the incredible legacy of David Bowie, a true innovator.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday on January 8, 2027.

angles.name: King Elvis 92
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page turns 83 on January 9, 2027.

angles.name: Page's 83rd
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard himself, Jimmy Page. Thank you for the riffs, sir.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic singer Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 on January 10, 2027.

angles.name: Rod's 82nd
angles.copy: The legendary Rod Stewart is 82 today! Still rocking and crooning with the best of them.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of Madness, turns 66 on January 13, 2027.

angles.name: Suggs' 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young turns 71 on January 17, 2027.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! We'll just have to play another one of his hits.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday on January 19, 2027.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the incomparable Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today! Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and singer-songwriter Gary Barlow turns 56 on January 20, 2027.

angles.name: Gary's 56th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still going strong after all these years.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B singer Billy Ocean turns 77 on January 21, 2027.

angles.name: Billy's 77th
angles.copy: Get outta my dreams, get into my car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Anniversary
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on January 23, 1986.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: On this day, we celebrate the legacy of rock and roll as we mark the anniversary of the very first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who's your favourite inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen turns 55 on January 27, 2027.

angles.name: Mark's 55th
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live public performance, the rooftop concert, on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles took to the roof for their legendary final live performance. What a moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer and drummer Phil Collins turns 76 on January 30, 2027.

angles.name: Phil's 76th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! Still 'In The Air Tonight' on our playlist.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake turns 46 on January 31, 2027.

angles.name: JT's 46th
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! Still bringing the 'SexyBack' to our airwaves.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason turns 87 on February 2, 2027.

angles.name: Del Boy's 87th
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure, from Del Boy to Jack Frost.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On February 3, 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as "The Day The Music Died."

angles.name: Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'. Their legacy lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Rick Astley turns 61 on February 6, 2027.

angles.name: Rick's 61st
angles.copy: Never gonna give him up! Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday on February 6, 2027.

angles.name: Bob's 82nd
angles.copy: Happy heavenly birthday to the King of Reggae, Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today. His music continues to spread love and unity.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Carole King turns 85 on February 9, 2027.

angles.name: Carole's 85th
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting legend who gave us so many timeless hits.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: The incomparable singer Whitney Houston passed away on February 11, 2012.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, who left us on this day in 2012. Her music will forever be loved.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Take That announced their initial split on February 13, 1996.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: 21 years ago today, hearts were broken across the nation as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Ali Campbell, the lead singer of UB40, turns 68 on February 15, 2027.

angles.name: Ali's 68th
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran turns 36 on February 17, 2027.

angles.name: Ed's 36th
angles.copy: Wishing a huge happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! Still dominating the charts and our playlists.
